title: Container Keeps Exiting Immediately
intro: You ran your new container and it's just... not there anymore. No error shown on screen.

steps.hint: docker ps only shows running containers — if it exited, it won't appear here.

steps.prompt: Check ALL containers, including stopped ones.
steps.fake_output:
CONTAINER ID   IMAGE      STATUS                     
b4c5d6e7f8a9   myapp:v2   Exited (1) 30 seconds ago
steps.hint: Add -a to see stopped/exited containers too.

steps.prompt: Check its logs to see why it exited.
steps.fake_output:
Error: Cannot find module 'express'
    at Function.Module._resolveFilename
steps.hint: Logs from an exited container are still available — this is where the actual error usually is.
Exit code 1 is a generic application error — worth confirming alongside the log message.

resolution: The image was built without running npm install first (or a layer got cached incorrectly), so 'express' was never installed inside the image — the app crashed instantly on require(). This is a build-time problem, not a runtime one: the fix is rebuilding the image after checking the Dockerfile actually runs the install step, ideally with --no-cache once to rule out a stale cached layer.
